scope: Four subtle variations of the user-selected orange drifting car logo. Existing production logo unchanged.

assets.name: 短胖小车
assets.change: Slightly shorten the car body by about 12 percent and make it 8 percent wider, with a gently larger cabin, giving a compact mischievous toy-car silhouette. Keep the exact same orange model features, window colors, headlights and rear lights. Wheels remain chunky but within an anatomically coherent four-wheel layout. Keep the same pose, skid marks and parking bay.

assets.name: 急转甩尾
assets.change: Increase the dynamic turning gesture slightly: rotate the car about 10 degrees clockwise within essentially the same composition, show the front tires countersteering a little more clearly, and let the tail swing a little farther left. Adjust the existing curved skid marks to follow that coherent sharper turn. Keep the car shape, size, palette, cream smoke and parking bay close to the reference; do not invent extra speed effects.
